name: Lisa Cayce Foster
original_name: リサ・ケイシー・フォスター
source:
Lisa is an American girl who has gone temporarily to Japan to study abroad. Lisa works part-time at a restaurant called Fuuruuyan and is where she meets [url=/c14771][/url]Naoki. Lisa's reason for studying in Japan is because of her interest in Japanese history and culture.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off:_Yubikiri_no_Kioku]Wikipedia[/url].]
